[[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] '''Olifer''' was stationed aboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[New Hope]]''<ref name="RA" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> During this time, Olifer was unaware that the ship's [[Technician/Legends|technician]], [[Wires]], was using thirty-two percent of the excess capacity of the ship's tracking computer to run a virtual gambling [[Casino/Legends|casino]]. When [[Chief Warrant Officer]] [[Xiong Wong]] needed Wires help in decoding a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]], Wong threatened to reveal the casino to Olifer if Wires did not comply. As a result, Wires decoded the datadisc, while Olifer remained ignorant of the casino.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Olifer was created for the [[1998]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', which was written by [[William C. Dietz]].<ref name="RA" />
